description: A person's history on their card, told as a short biography from the records the player would know of: born, school, a move, a partner, a child, work, a parent's death, what happened to them in play (a job lost, a move, an illness, the law, a home, a business), the offices they won (owner, Nov 1: "Elected legislator, it needs to be told like a story. How many times do I have to say that?"). Each sentence of the story (person-history.story.<key>) has three forms: said of someone in the third person (the first sentence names them, the rest use their recorded pronouns), in the they form, and in the first person (.i) for the player's own life on the You screen. A run of terms in one office is one sentence. The card shows the year beside each sentence, so a sentence leaves it out. person-history.summary.<key> are the lines under the name: who they are now, and where they come from.

slots.place: A place's name from the place records.
slots.month: The record's month and year, as people say it: January 2025.
slots.school: The school's name as its record writes it.
slots.name: A person's full name from their record.
slots.title: The job's title from the job record.
slots.employer: The employer's name from the organization record.
slots.relation: Mother or father, from the record, in lower case.
slots.office: The office won, in lower case: president, mayor.
slots.stage: The school stage as its record writes it: elementary, middle or high.
slots.who: The person the sentence is about: their full name in the story's first sentence, then their pronoun (She, He), from their record.
slots.their: Their possessive pronoun from their record (her, his).
slots.years: The later years they won the same office again, joined as a list: 2013 and 2015.
slots.state: A state's name from the place records: Ohio.
slots.whom: The person the story is about, as the object of a sentence: their full name the first time, then their pronoun (her, him).
slots.employers: The earlier employers as a spoken list: A, B and C.
slots.span: How long a stretch of work lasted, as people say it: nine years.
slots.here: The town or county the person lives in now, from the place records.
slots.age: How old the person was then, from their birth record and the record's date.
slots.child: A child's first name from their record.
slots.parent: Who the partner is to the viewer or to the person's children, said as the viewer would ("your father", "the children's mother"), from the child's other-parent record; said only when the record holds it.
slots.given: The first name of the person being talked about, from their record.
